caption_L1: Here a bar plot is named Number of automotive industry jobs at risk from work stoppages amid coronavirus pandemic in European markets as of March 2020. The y-axis plots Country on categorical scale starting at Austria and ending at United Kingdom while the x-axis measures Number of jobs along linear scale of range 0 to 600,000.
caption_L2L3: Of 17 countries covered by the survey, 14 reported that automotive jobs were at risk.  Germany had the greatest number of jobs at risk, with around 6 times more jobs at risk than the country with the next highest number, France.  With the exception of Germany, the number of jobs at risk by country was between 20,000 and 90,000.
